payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sieve for primes and loop to generate all palindromic numbers up to a fixed limit, then prefix sum to find the maximum n with π(n) ≤ (p/q)*rub(n).
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks all numbers up to 1.2e6 using precomputation rather than recursive backtracking or graph search. Among the given subtypes, search_backtracking is the only one that broadly covers exhaustive enumeration, even though the code lacks true backtracking behavior.
